text:
I had an appointment with the dentist, but I called the staff at the counter to reschedule. They probably didn't reschedule my appointment even though they had already agreed. Plus, I called at the wrong time! The dentist was angry at me for waiting so long and criticized me. I didn't mind, but they were really harsh on me. They grabbed me and yelled at me, and they didn't even let me rest. I asked a friend who had been there before, and they said they allowed me to rest and rinse my mouth halfway through. I was so disappointed. If I didn't want to do it, I wouldn't have done it. They were better off yelling at me and yelling at me in a rage. I felt so bad for letting myself go through this. If I could go back in time, I would have left the clinic. Chiang Mai doesn't have just one dental clinic.

(Update*) I had it done just before New Year's. After the appointment, I went to the counter and asked what time my appointment was. I saw the time on the table with my name on it, and it was still the same time. I understood the dentist and thought, "Oh, so he's angry because he's been waiting so long." The staff at the counter didn't change the time, but they took it out on my teeth. 😂 They even said I had a cavity. 7 teeth, so I was really shocked 😂
P.S. Before going, I called the clinic to reconfirm the new time. I showed up on time, but ended up being late, and the doctor waited for me at the usual time, so I had to wait a long time.
